name: writers-read-only-feedback
body:
Every writer agent the suite defines or scaffolds must hold no feedback-action capability: `apg_review_action` (and `apg_review_resolve`/`apg_review_reject`) is not granted to the spec-writer, the plan-writer, the implementer, or any test-implementer the agent-builder scaffolds, so a dispatched writer cannot move a feedback item's state. Each holds a read-only feedback channel (`apg_review`) and responds to the single item it was given with an ACTIONED or WONT-FIX claim returned to the coordinator — never by calling an action command.

Acceptance: none of the writer agent grants — the distributed suite templates (spec-writer, plan-writer) and every agent the agent-builder template scaffolds (the implementer and each test-implementer), plus this repo's generated agents — includes `apg_review_action`; each includes the read-only feedback channel; the agent-builder template states the same grant shape for its implementer AND test-implementer scaffolds.
